uncited: *   **Boundary Levels:** Levels at the top (root) or bottom (leaf) of the octree may lack adjacent coarser or finer levels.
*   **Time Complexity:** The MLP $g_\theta$ is invoked once per visible level, not once per visible anchor.
*   **Per-Anchor:** Computes a distinct $\delta_i$ for every anchor via spatial lookup.
It was developed to address the lack of cross-level gradient pathways in existing anchor-based octree pipelines.
